info.name: SCIM Server
info.summary: Account lifecycle management from an identity provider such as authentik, using SCIM 2.0
info.description:
**Caution: this app was programmed entirely with AI (Claude Code).** It has unit tests and an automated end-to-end suite, and has been tested by hand with authentik (OpenID Connect) and Microsoft Entra ID (SAML). It creates, disables and deletes accounts: try it on a test instance first and keep backups.
Lets an external identity provider manage Nextcloud accounts and groups through **SCIM 2.0**, with no extra service to run. Tested with **authentik** and **Microsoft Entra ID**; other SCIM 2.0 clients (Okta, ...) should work but are untested.
- Accounts are **provisioned** when they appear in the IdP and **updated** when they change (display name, email, group membership). - Deprovisioning is up to you: **disable** the account, **disable and delete after N days** (you set N), or delete at once. Accounts disabled in the IdP are blocked from logging in, and reactivated when they come back. - **Groups** are created, renamed and deleted with their members. A name filter (regular expression) and a prefix (for example for the `SAML_` groups of user_saml) decide which groups land in Nextcloud and under which name. - **Safe by default**: SCIM only manages the accounts and groups it created, administrators and the admin group are protected, SCIM is refused over plain HTTP, and it authenticates with revocable bearer tokens that are stored hashed.
Users still sign in through your SSO app (user_oidc or user_saml); this app only manages their lifecycle. See the README for the setup with authentik and Microsoft Entra ID.
